@@name@@Blade of the Exile@@icon@@Blade of the Exile.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@icon3@@{{{icon3}}}@@icon4@@{{{icon4}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Riven''' empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining 20% AD [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage, [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 75 '''bonus''' attack range, and increased range on ''[[File:Riven Broken Wings.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Broken Wings|An icon for Riven's ability Broken Wings]] [[Riven#Broken Wings|Broken Wings]]'' and ''[[File:Riven Ki Burst.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Ki Burst|An icon for Riven's ability Ki Burst]] [[Riven#Ki Burst|Ki Burst]]''.

After 0.5 seconds, she can cast ''[[File:Riven Wind Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Wind Slash|An icon for Riven's ability Wind Slash]] [[Riven#Wind Slash|Wind Slash]]'' within the duration.@@description2@@{{{description2}}}@@description3@@{{{description3}}}@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@120 / 105 / 90 / 75 / 60@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * All bonuses are gained after 0.5 seconds of the ability starting its cast. ** The '''bonus''' attack damage amount is factored upon cast, and does not change. * If '''Riven''' has a basic attack buffered before the end of ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time, the buffered basic attack will start 0.33 seconds after the end of the cast time. ** The delay will not apply to basic attack commands input after ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time.@@

@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@[[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 200@@speed@@1600@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@{{{cooldown}}}@@targeting@@Direction@@damagetype@@physical@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@true@@notes@@ * ''Wind Slash'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of cast time. * ''Wind Slash's'' wave is made up of three individual missiles spread in a cone. ** Each enemy can be damaged by only one missile. * If ''Wind Slash'' hits an enemy while ''Riven'' is not visible, it will briefly grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area around her to enemies. * If '''Riven''' has a basic attack buffered before the end of ''Wind Slash's'' cast time, the buffered basic attack will start 0.528 seconds after the end of the cast time. ** The delay is not applied if a basic attack command is input after the cast time.@@
